title: GET /api/projects/:id/timeline — paginated timeline events with type filter
description: Return paginated timeline events for a project, newest first, with optional event type filter.
acceptanceCriteria: GET requires auth and project ownership
Returns events ordered by created_at DESC

steps.description: Create timeline router and implement GET /
steps.details: Create server/src/routes/timeline.ts. Parse query params: page, limit (max 100), type (split on comma). Build query: WHERE project_id = id AND (type IN types if provided). ORDER BY created_at DESC. LIMIT + OFFSET. Return { events, total, page, limit }.
Create journal entry, complete milestone, complete todo. GET timeline — verify all 3 types present. GET ?type=journal — verify only journal events. GET ?page=2&limit=2 — verify pagination.
